entries.basis: Three distinct published first-generation L8 Pro driving accounts: Xchuxing prospective owner 电动胡辣汤 Dec1 2022 (20-inch, sport/lowest suspension); Autohome certified owner 减脂管理师Manson Feb1 2023 after1110km; Drom Oct2 2023 curated translation of a foreign owner describing three test drives. Drom original reviewer name/Chinese URL unpublished; credit the published Russian translation and do not claim identity verification. Account detail differs from other two, no duplicate reused. Three publishers, owner/prospective-owner evidence rather than three instrumented editorial tests. No Max ADAS, later facelift or five-seat2026 substitution. All axes preserved.
